title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: The right side of the abdomen of a supine adult, seen from above the right flank: head off the left, feet off the right, the umbilicus toward the top, the flank meeting the drape along the bottom.
teachingPoint: The probe lies transverse on the mid-axillary line midway between the costal margin and the iliac crest; the needle enters at its anterior end.
claims: Probe transverse on the lateral abdominal wall at the mid-axillary line, midway between the costal margin and the iliac crest (record).
Needle in-plane from the anterior end, aimed posteriorly (record: anterior to posterior or the reverse).
Costal margin and iliac crest about 11 cm apart at the mid-axillary line (typical adult).
A gloved hand holds the probe (owner, 2026-10-15).
Dashed mid-axillary line through the probe face; the costal margin (under the gown) and the iliac crest (under the hand) are not labelled.
Labels: Mid-axillary line, Linear probe, Block needle.
